item.title: Speech Translation
item.description:
Speech Translation is a bilingual Arabic and English transcription and translation platform with a robust backend enabling live broadcastable sessions.

Overview

A platform for live speech translation between Arabic and English, supporting broadcast-quality sessions with a scalable backend infrastructure.

Key Features

  • Bilingual support: Arabic and English transcription and translation
  • Live sessions: Real-time translation for broadcast-quality interactions
  • Scalable backend: Robust infrastructure handling concurrent sessions

Tech Stack

React, NodeJS, MongoDB, Nginx, Puppeteer, and Artillery.io for load testing.
